{{Quote|I think I know who did it, who blew up the hangar.|This witness, after overhearing a conversation about a recent incident|<ref name="Sabotage" />}}
A '''Pantoran''' was an employee of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was employed by the Jedi Order as a maintenance worker at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Stationed at the Temple's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] was a survivor of a [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing]] during the Clone Wars. When questioned by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Russo-ISC/Legends|Russo-ISC]], he revealed that he believed that [[Jackar Bowmani/Legends|Jackar Bowmani]] was responsible for the bombing.<ref name="Sabotage" />
